availability_check: 2026-11-16 via Claude Code CLI, provider firstParty, costBasis list

calls.purpose: specification-only Eiffel atmosphere / site ground / iron finish / steam module

cost_note: Costs are the CLI's list-price estimates (total_cost_usd). Invoice settlement was not checked.
prompt_contents: A written specification of coordinate frame, light setup, shader-chunk constraints, determinism and performance limits. No repository source, records, keys or personal data.
integration_refinements: bluer zenith gradient and narrower haze band after same-camera review (the first output read greyer than the original sky)
darker earth/damp/quay and desaturated river colours for ACES output
raised ground patch, drift and haul-path contrast
steam opacity 0.55 -> 0.42 for close inspection stops
iron patch applied after the existing quality surface so each program keeps a distinct cache key; ground excluded from that surface pass
explicit lattice shadow casting with clipShadows so unbuilt members cast no shadow
